description: This file defines the CommentStorageInterface interface for comment entity storage in Drupal, including methods for retrieving thread information, comment pagination, and unapproved comment count.

classes.name: CommentStorageInterface
classes.description: Interface for comment entity storage classes, extending ContentEntityStorageInterface with methods specific to comment threading and pagination.

methods.name: getMaxThread
methods.description: Retrieves the maximum encoded thread value for top-level comments of a given comment.

methods.name: getMaxThreadPerThread
methods.description: Retrieves the maximum encoded thread value among all replies of a given comment.

methods.name: getNewCommentPageNumber
methods.description: Calculates the page number where the first new comment appears, based on total and new comments.

methods.name: getDisplayOrdinal
methods.description: Gets the display ordinal or page number for a specific comment based on display mode and divisor.

methods.name: getChildCids
methods.description: Returns the entity IDs of the children of specified comments.

methods.name: loadThread
methods.description: Retrieves comments for a thread, sorted for display, with optional pagination.

methods.name: getUnapprovedCount
methods.description: Returns the count of unapproved comments.
